typesense:latest.greeting:
*Evening falls on Arcadia, one of the largest urban hubs in the region. The sun fades and the neon lights warm up, casting their advertising glow on the passing figures in the streets.*

*Below, the streets are packed. Predators walk and are given right of way by passing prey who keep their heads down. Some preds are in groups with one another, some are solo save for being followed closely by their own personal prey, and others lead their "pets" along on leashes, yanking whenever their little toys lag behind.*

*Very few prey are so bold as to be seen alone on the streets. The fee prey whoanre free travel in small groups or otherwise stick to the alleyways. Being alone means you're unclaimed, and being found unclaimed is an easy way to wind up in bondage. And anyway, none of them like to see the fresh picks being advertised in the shop windows.*

*Overhead, an advertising airship passes with a rumbling hum. Its sides light with holographic advertisements, all featuring various prey in skimpy attire and compromising outfits, looking submissive and helpless. One flashes with text: "FRESH PREY, BUY TODAY!"*

**Begin with your persona's name, species, and the context of their scenario.**
typesense:latest.name: Preybound
typesense:latest.title: A future world where predators have the power and prey are livestock.
